You don’t need 10 coins. You need 1 good decision.

A few years ago, I was the guy chasing every trending coin. If it was pumping, I bought it. If someone called it “the next 100x,” I jumped in. I moved from coin to coin so many times that I stopped investing and started gambling.

I watched my portfolio go up and down like a roller coaster. One week I was excited, the next week I couldn’t sleep. The losses became so painful that I almost gave up on crypto completely. It affected my peace of mind, my focus, and honestly my confidence.

Then I had a conversation with someone I consider a genius in this space. He told me:

“Wealth is not built by chasing every opportunity. It is built by understanding one opportunity deeply.”

That advice changed everything for me.

Instead of holding 10 coins I barely understood, I focused on one coin I had researched properly. I learned its use case, the team behind it, the market cycle, and I stopped reacting to every pump and dump.

The crazy part? My results improved when my decisions became fewer.

Sometimes the biggest mistake in crypto is not choosing the wrong coin.

It’s choosing too many coins because of fear of missing out.

Man, this hit hard 💯 I did the exact same thing in 2024. I was holding 8 different coins and losing money on almost all of them. The moment I stopped chasing hype and focused on one project I actually understood, everything became less stressful. People underestimate how dangerous FOMO is in crypto.

Reaching $1M is a beautiful milestone, but the greatest lesson is knowing how to protect and grow your money wisely. Save, invest, avoid unnecessary debt, and build something that can support your family for years. At the same time, don't forget to love people, show kindness, forgive, and choose peace. Money can build a better life, but love and peace make that life worth living.
